acceptance_criteria: Every finding in the assigned set (F-001, F-002, F-003, F-008, F-013) receives an explicit disposition of fixed, partially-fixed, not-fixed or fixed-with-new-risk, each with concrete evidence.
Any new defect introduced by a fix is reported with severity, file:line and a concrete failure scenario, including defects outside the assigned set that are encountered in the changed code.

The five non-negotiable criteria in the shared review context are checked and reported on: no test weakened, no strict schema loosened, no secret leakage, exit-code contract intact, prototype scope respected.
Findings are ranked by severity and each states whether it blocks acceptance of the fix wave.

Load and follow the project review-logic skill at .metaproject/skills/gdskills/review/review-logic/SKILL.md.

Read .metaproject/flows/001-2026-09-05-echolet-assessment-fixes/reviews/2026-09-06-fixreview-echolet-cli-prototype-t38/inputs/review-context.md FIRST: it carries the disposition vocabulary, the worker-reported concerns and the five non-negotiable review criteria.
You are a reviewer. Do NOT modify any source file, test file or configuration. Do not fix what you find - report it.
You did not write these fixes and must not accept them on the implementer's word. Verify against the code.
Every disposition needs concrete evidence: file:line, a control-flow argument, or a bounded read-only probe. A disposition without evidence is not acceptable.
The repository is on unborn `main` with everything untracked, so an empty `git diff` is NOT an empty change set. Review the working tree.
Do not re-run the full verification matrix; T37 already did and passed. A bounded targeted probe is fine when you need one.
Do not edit flow.json or acceptance-criteria.md.
Use `keryx ctx rg` for searches, never bare rg/grep. Use `keryx ctx run` for long command output.
Never print plaintext message bodies, ciphertext, profile store keys, private key material or HTTP request bodies into your report - describe leakage findings by location and mechanism only.
Do not commit and do not create a branch, PR or remote.
Respect prototype scope: this is a local computer CLI prototype. Do not raise findings demanding production hardening, mobile support, deployment or external audit.

Pay particular attention to F-003: discrimination is by ORIGIN using an Object.is identity check inside Profile.transact(). Confirm that a store-machinery failure cannot be misclassified as a domain error and, more importantly, that a domain error cannot be swallowed as PERSISTENCE_FAILURE - and that the exit-3 control path is genuinely unreachable from exit 5.
For F-008 confirm the outbox recheck is inside the SAME transaction that encrypts and writes history, and that returning the persisted record cannot skip a required state transition.

For F-013 confirm inlineStringOptionValues cannot consume an argument it should not: boolean options, an option already in inline form, an option with nothing after it, and everything after a bare `--`.
